ns2:section.sectionText: Psyc 593 – Statistical Learning for Behavioral Data An incomplete survey of statistical machine learning methods for large-scale behavioral data (e.g., item responses, choices, ratings, text, computer log) from psychological/educational tests, surveys, and observational studies. A combination of lectures, assigned reading discussion, and data analysis activities. Prerequisites: PSYC 594, familiarity with R, and one of the following: PSYC 589, EPSY 590 (Bayesian), or PSYC 596.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Psychology major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
